text:
lex_marketing: Heads-up: aiming to announce 'Orbit' release next Tue 09:00 PT. Need final changelog link, staging docs URL, a single benchmark sentence for the hero, canary/ramp windows, and webinar ownership (30m).

sam_eng: I will post the changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelogs/pull/523 (sha `d1e5b9c`). Canary plan: 09:00 canary 5m, 20% at 09:05, 60% at 09:12, full at 09:25. Fallback tag: orbit-legacy. Ops standby.

priya_docs: Staging docs published: https://docs.redwood.dev/staging/orbit. I'll add migration notes and a compact quickstart. Marketing: paste the canonical docs link into the announcement draft when ready.

nico_research: Benchmark blurb: "Orbit reduces token spend by ~2.3x on sparse long-context workloads and halves p95 latency at 16k tokens." I'll confirm with one final overnight regression and report by 07:30 PT.

lex_marketing: Nice. Webinar: Evan, you to demo? Email send ~5m after full rollout.

ev an_pm: Yes, I'll lead demo; Priya does migration bits, Nico covers benchmarks. I'll own the runbook and rollback steps.

sam_eng: Runbook snippet: `kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/reinference --to-revision=4`. Post-deploy checks: KV hit-rate and p95.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment: release-orbit start=5612339900 canary_window=300s full_rollout=5612340300. CI: all checks passed. :white_check_mark:

lex_marketing: Proposed timeline: 09:00 canary, 09:25 full, 09:30 blog + docs live, 09:35 email, 11:00 webinar. I'll drop the announcement draft here by EOD for review. Ping for any last-minute changes. :wave:
